cues.en: So, our goal this time around is to get Postgres up and running with the pgvector installed and to have our database set up, and we have a very simple database.
cues.zh: 這堂課的目標，是啟動已安裝 pgvector 的 Postgres，並建立資料庫。我們的資料庫相當簡單。

cues.en: Now if you go to the course resources for this lecture, you'll see a file named db.zip.
cues.zh: 到這堂課的課程資源，會看到一個叫 db.zip 的檔案。

cues.en: Download that, unzip it, and put the file and the directory that exists in that archive over in your root project of your folder.
cues.zh: 下載、解壓縮後，把壓縮檔裡的檔案與目錄放到專案根目錄。

cues.en: So you'll wind up with this file, docker-compose.yml, and you'll wind up with this directory, db, which has one file called init.sql.
cues.zh: 最後會有 docker-compose.yml，以及 db 目錄，裡面只有一個 init.sql。

cues.en: Well, let's have a look at the docker-compose first, okay?
cues.zh: 先看看 docker-compose 的內容。

cues.en: Now this has two services, one that will come up by default when we bring up Docker and an optional one that we'll be using later on in the course.
cues.zh: 它定義了兩個服務：一個在啟動 Docker 時預設就會啟動，另一個是稍後課程才會用到的選用服務。

cues.en: This one is for Postgres, and this one is for Weaviate, okay, a different kind of vector store that we'll be doing later on.
cues.zh: 這個是 Postgres，另一個是 Weaviate，也就是稍後會使用的另一種向量儲存區。

cues.en: Now you'll notice here in the Postgres service that we have a volumes section that tells
cues.zh: 注意 Postgres 服務裡有 volumes 設定，用來告訴

cues.en: Docker where the data lives in the container for Postgres, and it also has this init script that says the first time it comes up, check to make sure that this has already run, okay?
cues.zh: Docker，Postgres 容器中的資料存放在哪裡；另外還有初始化腳本，在第一次啟動時會檢查它是否已經執行。

cues.en: And we'll look at that in just a minute.
cues.zh: 稍後就會看那個腳本。

cues.en: A few things to bear in mind.
cues.zh: 有幾件事要注意。

cues.en: First of all, we're not using the regular Postgres.
cues.zh: 首先，我們不是使用一般的 Postgres，

cues.en: We're using a special container that supports the Postgres PG vector extension, which we absolutely need.
cues.zh: 而是支援 Postgres pgvector 擴充功能的特殊容器，而這正是我們必要的功能。

cues.en: Without that extension, we wouldn't be able to have a vector store in the first place.
cues.zh: 沒有這個擴充功能，就根本無法建立向量儲存區。

cues.en: So this is an official Postgres distribution or container, and it's called pgvector slash pgvector colon pg18.
cues.zh: 這是一個 Postgres 發行映像檔或容器，名稱是 pgvector/pgvector:pg18。

cues.en: So it's Postgres 18 with the pgvector extension available, okay?
cues.zh: 也就是提供 pgvector 擴充功能的 Postgres 18。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at the init SQL script over here in the db directory.
cues.zh: 接著看看 db 目錄中的 init.sql 腳本。

cues.en: The first thing you have to do, even though Postgres pg18 has the pgvector installed, you need to actually run this little bit of SQL.
cues.zh: 第一件要做的事是，雖然這個 Postgres pg18 已安裝 pgvector，但仍必須執行這一小段 SQL。

cues.en: And of course, this will run automatically the first time we bring up Docker.
cues.zh: 當然，第一次啟動 Docker 時它會自動執行。

cues.en: Create extension, if not exists, vector, okay?
cues.zh: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector。

cues.en: Now the rest of this is just straightforward.
cues.zh: 其餘內容都很直接，

cues.en: We create a table called documents with these fields, and we create a table called chunks with these fields, okay?
cues.zh: 建立一個有這些欄位的 documents 表，以及具有這些欄位的 chunks 表。

cues.en: And then we create some indices.
cues.zh: 接著建立一些索引。

cues.en: So let's open our terminal, and we just type docker compose up dash d.
cues.zh: 現在開啟終端機，輸入 docker compose up -d。

cues.en: And that pulls the necessary things.
cues.zh: 它會下載必要的內容。

cues.en: If we go back over to docker compose, let me close the terminal, we go back over to docker compose dot yml, you see that we have the username set here.
cues.zh: 回到 docker-compose.yml；先關閉終端機。可以看到這裡已設定使用者名稱。

cues.en: And of course, ours is going to be pyreg, pyreg, pyreg, okay?
cues.zh: 我們的設定當然都是 pyrag、pyrag、pyrag。

cues.en: So just to make sure that everything worked, I'll open my favorite Postgres client, mine happens to be Postico, and I'll create a new server, and I'll call it pyreg local, and
cues.zh: 為了確定全部正常，我開啟自己慣用的 Postgres 用戶端 Postico，建立新伺服器，命名為 pyrag local，

cues.en: my host is localhost, port is 5432, the database is pyreg, the username is pyreg, and the password is also pyreg, okay?
cues.zh: 主機是 localhost、連接埠 5432、資料庫 pyrag、使用者 pyrag，密碼也同樣是 pyrag。

cues.en: And I'll test my connection, and it worked, and I'll connect.
cues.zh: 測試連線，成功了，再連接資料庫。

cues.en: And you see I have a documents table right here, and if we look at the structure, it's very simple.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 documents 表，結構非常簡單。

cues.en: It has an ID, a source path, where does the source exist, the content hash, which we'll be talking about later on, when it was ingested, the metadata, and the chunk count.
cues.zh: 包含 ID、來源檔案的 source_path、content_hash，稍後會談、匯入時間、metadata 和 chunk_count。

cues.en: And the actual chunks, of course, have a foreign key to that, here, document ID, and this is where we store the individual chunks, okay?
cues.zh: 實際的 chunks 當然透過外鍵連到它，也就是這裡的 document_id；各個文字區塊就存放在這張表。

cues.en: So that seemed to work, so now we have a place to store our documents, which means we need to get started actually implementing the store in Python, and we'll get started on that in
cues.zh: 看起來運作成功，現在有地方儲存文件了，也就表示該開始在 Python 裡實作儲存區；我們會在

cues.zh: 下一堂開始。
